name: @lastest/plugin-qa-agent
description: QA Agent: an orchestrated nine-phase agent team (preflight, login resolution, discovery crawl + explorer swarm, coverage planning, human review gate, generation, execution, healing, summary) plus a direction queue and cron/PR automation triggers. The last RFC §9 pseudo-plugin to graduate. Sessions stay in core's agent_sessions (kind "qa") behind QaAgentHost — see host.ts item 1 for the shared-encryption reasoning inherited from quickstart. No typecheck script on purpose — DrivablePage resolves to unknown without @lastest/core-browser in the program, which no plugin may import; the app's own tsc covers these files.
